sources.t: Social tariffs: Cheaper broadband and phone packages
sources.f: Updated 22 June 2026; Ofcom lists lower-cost broadband and phone packages for eligible benefit recipients and notes current tariff characteristics.
sources.g: A tariff list describes affordability and does not prove network availability or orderability at an exact premises.

sources.t: Telecoms price rises – what are your rights?
sources.f: Updated 29 June 2026; Ofcom explains the pounds-and-pence transparency rules applying to specified in-contract price rises in new contracts.
sources.g: Contract-price protections are consumer-rights evidence, not physical network-reach evidence.

sources.t: Signal struggles on trains widespread, Ofcom research finds
sources.f: Published 3 June 2026; Ofcom reports mobile performance testing across 24 railway segments and identifies widespread poor-quality service.
sources.g: Route-level train testing does not establish fixed or mobile connectivity at a specific parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – South Yorkshire
sources.f: Published 10 April 2024; BDUK records a Quickline contract for around 32,100 hard-to-reach premises, subject to detailed planning and technical change.
sources.g: Awarded and planned contract scope is not current exact-address retail availability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – Mid West Shropshire
sources.f: Updated 10 October 2025; BDUK records termination of the Voneus contract and transfer of premises into an Openreach call-off arrangement.
sources.g: Contract termination and replacement planning do not prove a completed connection at a premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – West Herefordshire and Forest of Dean
sources.f: Updated 14 April 2026; BDUK records termination of the FullFibre contract and inclusion of West Herefordshire in an Openreach call-off.
sources.g: Programme reassignment is not exact current serviceability evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – South Wiltshire
sources.f: Published 10 April 2024; BDUK records a Wessex Internet contract for around 14,500 premises and states that detailed planning may change scope.
sources.g: Contract scope and anticipated access dates require fresh UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - East Gloucestershire
sources.f: Published 22 February 2024; BDUK records a Gigaclear contract for around 4,400 hard-to-reach premises.
sources.g: A regional award does not prove present orderability for an exact address.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Leicestershire and Warwickshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the CityFibre contract to around 36,000 premises after commercial-rollout changes.
sources.g: Redesigned programme scope remains planned evidence rather than live parcel truth.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the contract from around 25,000 to around 6,000 premises.
sources.g: Changing contract scope cannot establish current retail availability at a premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Kent
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the Kent contract to around 9,000 premises backed by revised investment.
sources.g: Regional redesign and investment figures are not exact-address service checks.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Nottinghamshire and West Lincolnshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records that CityFibre is no longer delivering this contract and that alternative supplier discussions continue.
sources.g: A terminated contract and future discussions do not prove current premises connectivity.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - East and West Sussex
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the contract to around 13,000 premises following commercial-rollout changes.
sources.g: Revised regional build scope remains non-parcel programme evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire and East Berkshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the contract to around 6,000 premises backed by £24.4 million.
sources.g: Contract and investment records require current exact-address validation before promotion.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Derbyshire
sources.f: Published 15 December 2023; BDUK records a Connect Fibre contract for more than 17,000 hard-to-reach premises.
sources.g: An awarded regional contract is not proof of completed or orderable service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - North East Staffordshire
sources.f: Published 25 November 2023; BDUK records a Connect Fibre contract for around 6,000 premises, with scope subject to detailed planning.
sources.g: Planned scope does not establish current exact-premises connectivity.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contracts - Oxfordshire
sources.f: Published 25 November 2023; BDUK records two Gigaclear contracts for around 10,000 premises in North and South Oxfordshire.
sources.g: Contract totals and anticipated dates do not prove present address orderability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Hampshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the Hampshire contract to around 29,000 premises.
sources.g: Redesigned contract scope is not a live provider availability result.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Suffolk
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the Suffolk contract to around 60,000 premises.
sources.g: Programme scope and investment do not establish current exact-address service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Norfolk
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records redesign of the Norfolk contract to around 33,000 premises backed by £61.9 million.
sources.g: A redesigned regional contract requires fresh UPRN and retail-provider validation before parcel promotion.
